title: Bug 649440: [Subcontracting] [IT] Disable Legacy Subcontracting leaves Component Supply Method empty after conversion
summary: The Italian subcontracting legacy migration now correctly maps the vendor's procurement setting to the component supply method for both production BOM lines and existing production-order components during conversion.
key_points: Maps legacy vendor procurement settings to component supply method via routing links and work centers
Handles both production BOM lines and existing production-order components
Preserves existing nonblank methods and skips already-migrated rows for efficiency
Evaluates routing versions, BOM/version date intervals, and handles family routings
Extends pre-migration locking to all newly read source tables
quote: Component Supply Method remained blank on linked production BOM lines and existing production-order components.
